evidence.title: vllm-project/vllm: v0.28.0rc2: [Spec Decode] DFlash2: local convolution + candidate selector (#52816)

summary: The vLLM project introduces version 0.28.0rc2, featuring DFlash2, a new speculative decoding method combining local convolution and a candidate selector to improve inference efficiency. This update aims to enhance performance for large language models by optimizing token generation.
title: vLLM Releases v0.28.0rc2 with DFlash2: Local Convolution and Candidate Selector for Speculative Decoding
